graph_discipline: Roots are nodes; branches remain edge or port labels.

root_resolution.note: The basmala is included in the analysis frame. It strengthens divine-name, worship, mercy, prayer, and purification activations but introduces no additional branch inventory roots.

surface_mechanism: 87:7 places divine will and divine knowledge over both what is public and what is hidden.
87:8 joins divine facilitation to the easy course.
87:9-10 makes reminder conditional on benefit and depicts reverent fear as the disposition that remembers.
87:11-13 contrasts avoidance with the most wretched person's encounter with the greatest fire and a suspended state of neither death nor life.
